verses.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.pt: O homem, nascido da mulher, é de poucos dias e cheio de inquietação.
verses.en_web: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: As for man, the son of woman, his days are short and full of trouble.

verses.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.pt: Nasce como a flor, e murcha; foge também como a sombra, e não permanece.
verses.en_web: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
verses.en_bbe: He comes out like a flower, and is cut down: he goes in flight like a shade, and is never seen again.

verses.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.pt: Sobre esse tal abres os teus olhos, e a mim me fazes entrar em juízo contigo?
verses.en_web: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
verses.en_bbe: Is it on such a one as this that your eyes are fixed, with the purpose of judging him?

verses.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.pt: Quem do imundo tirará o puro? Ninguém.
verses.en_web: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
verses.en_bbe: If only a clean thing might come out of an unclean! But it is not possible.

verses.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.pt: Visto que os seus dias estão determinados, contigo está o número dos seus meses; tu lhe puseste limites, e ele não poderá passar além deles.
verses.en_web: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;
verses.en_bbe: If his days are ordered, and you have knowledge of the number of his months, having given him a fixed limit past which he may not go;

verses.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.pt: Desvia dele o teu rosto, para que ele descanse e, como o jornaleiro, tenha contentamento no seu dia.
verses.en_web: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be turned away from him, and take your hand from him, so that he may have pleasure at the end of his day, like a servant working for payment.

verses.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.pt: Porque há esperança para a árvore, que, se for cortada, ainda torne a brotar, e que não cessem os seus renovos.
verses.en_web: “For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
verses.en_bbe: For there is hope of a tree; if it is cut down, it will come to life again, and its branches will not come to an end.

verses.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.pt: Ainda que envelheça a sua raiz na terra, e morra o seu tronco no pó,
verses.en_web: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
verses.en_bbe: Though its root may be old in the earth, and its cut-off end may be dead in the dust;

verses.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.pt: contudo ao cheiro das águas brotará, e lançará ramos como uma planta nova.
verses.en_web: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
verses.en_bbe: Still, at the smell of water, it will make buds, and put out branches like a young plant.

verses.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.pt: O homem, porém, morre e se desfaz; sim, rende o homem o espírito, e então onde está?
verses.en_web: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
verses.en_bbe: But man comes to his death and is gone: he gives up his spirit, and where is he?

verses.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.pt: Como as águas se retiram de um lago, e um rio se esgota e seca,
verses.en_web: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
verses.en_bbe: The waters go from a pool, and a river becomes waste and dry;

verses.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.pt: assim o homem se deita, e não se levanta; até que não haja mais céus não acordará nem será despertado de seu sono.
verses.en_web: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they shall not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
verses.en_bbe: So man goes down to his last resting-place and comes not again: till the heavens come to an end, they will not be awake or come out of their sleep.

verses.en: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.pt: Oxalá me escondesses no Seol, e me ocultasses até que a tua ira tenha passado; que me determinasses um tempo, e te lembrasses de mim!
verses.en_web: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret, until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.en_bbe: If only you would keep me safe in the underworld, putting me in a secret place till your wrath is past, giving me a fixed time when I might come to your memory again!

verses.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.pt: Morrendo o homem, acaso tornará a viver? Todos os dias da minha lida esperaria eu, até que viesse a minha mudança.
verses.en_web: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my warfare would I wait, until my release should come.
verses.en_bbe: If death takes a man, will he come to life again? All the days of my trouble I would be waiting, till the time came for me to be free.

verses.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.pt: Chamar-me-ias, e eu te responderia; almejarias a obra de tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire to the work of your hands.
verses.en_bbe: At the sound of your voice I would give an answer, and you would have a desire for the work of your hands.

verses.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.pt: Então contarias os meus passos; não estarias a vigiar sobre o meu pecado;
verses.en_web: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
verses.en_bbe: For now my steps are numbered by you, and my sin is not overlooked.

verses.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.pt: a minha transgressão estaria selada num saco, e ocultarias a minha iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: My wrongdoing is corded up in a bag, and my sin is shut up safe.

verses.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.pt: Mas, na verdade, a montanha cai e se desfaz, e a rocha se remove do seu lugar.
verses.en_web: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;
verses.en_bbe: But truly a mountain falling comes to dust, and a rock is moved from its place;

verses.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.pt: As águas gastam as pedras; as enchentes arrebatam o solo; assim tu fazes perecer a esperança do homem.
verses.en_web: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
verses.en_bbe: The stones are crushed small by the force of the waters; the dust of the earth is washed away by their overflowing: and so you put an end to the hope of man.

verses.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.pt: Prevaleces para sempre contra ele, e ele passa; mudas o seu rosto e o despedes.
verses.en_web: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
verses.en_bbe: You overcome him for ever, and he is gone; his face is changed in death, and you send him away.

verses.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.pt: Os seus filhos recebem honras, sem que ele o saiba; são humilhados sem que ele o perceba.
verses.en_web: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
verses.en_bbe: His sons come to honour, and he has no knowledge of it; they are made low, but he is not conscious of it.

verses.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.pt: Sente as dores do seu próprio corpo somente, e só por si mesmo lamenta.
verses.en_web: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
verses.en_bbe: Only his flesh still has pain, and his soul is sad.
